assignment: Vettius Valens, Anthologiae Liber II capp. 37-41 (with the tail of cap. 36 that runs onto printed p. 114), Kroll 1908 printed pp. 114-131 = PDF page indices 132-149
calibration_notes: Fount trap kappa/chi: this Teubner Greek italic draws kappa almost as chi at scan resolution. All of kappa-initial vocabulary in II.37-41 (kleros, kyrios, kakopoioi, katholou, kentron, Kronos, kakodaimonon, kollesis) was resolved by lexicon, not by pixel, per the protocol. Genuine chi kept in chronon, tyches, psyche, schema, chorismous, cheiron, chera.
Iota subscript preserved: zodion / zodio, hypogeio, oikeio, to auto, he mesouranese, subjunctives in -e (diametrese, epimartyrese).

p.114 line 31: the printed text is 'ei de kai to zodion e blosyroteron'; the accented form in the image is ambiguous between the disjunctive e and the subjunctive e (with iota subscript). Sense requires the subjunctive of eimi, so it is transcribed as the subjunctive; Kroll's apparatus at that line records only blossyroteron V.
p.114 line 32: text prints epitaktikoteroi; Kroll's apparatus conjectures epiteuktikoteroi ('opinor'), recording -koteroi Va and -koteroi Vb. Both recorded in the rule's kroll_notes.
p.118 line 5: the manuscript form printed reads as moichainousi (they commit adultery); the alpha-iota ligature at scan resolution can be misread as alpha-lambda. Resolved by lexicon.

p.119 line 20: Valens writes 'houtos gar sympathes kai paranomos ho gamos krithesetai'. paranomos ('lawless') is what is printed and is retained; the sense of the sentence would suit paramonos ('enduring') and this is flagged as an unresolved reading, not emended.

p.118 lines 15 and 22 carry Kroll's own marks that are reproduced in the rules: three asterisks for a lacuna after hypotetagmenais (l.15) and an obelus before hysteros (l.22, apparatus: 'steiroi opinor, nisi praestat hysterousi').

Angle-bracketed supplements by Kroll that were encoded verbatim: <mete> at p.115 l.13, <syschematizomenos> at p.118 l.14, <eph'> at p.118 l.30, <lz'> <le'> <lth'> <m'> <ma'> chapter numerals throughout (Kroll supplies the chapter numbers).
No cell in this fragment was left partly read; every rule is graded A. Nothing in II.37-41 required a drop to C.
